question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Accompanyment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Accompanyment"** is incorrectly spelt. **Accompanyment** is not a valid word.
 
• The intended word is "**Accompaniment**", which means a musical part that supports or partners a solo instrument, voice, or group. (संगत)
 
 
• **Example:** The piano **accompaniment **added depth to the singer's performance.
 
 
 
• **Accompaniment** (संगत) is the correct spelling.
 
 
• **Example:** She played the guitar as an **accompaniment **to her singing.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wrestler** (पहलवान): A person who takes part in wrestling.

 
 
• **Example:** The **wrestler **won the championship after a gruelling match.
 
 
 
• **Debatable** (विवादास्पद): Open to discussion or argument.
 
 
• **Example:** The effectiveness of the new policy is **debatable**.
 
 
 
• **Discrepancy** (असंगति): A lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a **discrepancy **in the financial report that needed to be addressed.
